title: Setting the step budget
statement: Let $e$ be a record with natural-number fields for the circuit-input count, hard-wired-bit count, step budget, current instruction, preceding cell, first instruction of the current step, two loop counters, hard-wired and free input positions, and scratch space. Setting its step budget to $v$ gives the record obtained by replacing that field with $v$ and leaving every other field unchanged.
